#!/bin/bash

# CPU Monitoring Script
# Samples CPU usage every 5 seconds for 1 minute (12 samples)

LOG_FILE="/workspace/cpu_monitor.log"
SAMPLES=12
INTERVAL=5

# Function to get CPU usage percentage
get_cpu_usage() {
    # Read /proc/stat to compute CPU usage
    read cpu user nice system idle iowait irq softirq steal _ < /proc/stat
    local total1=$((user + nice + system + idle + iowait + irq + softirq + steal))
    local idle1=$((idle + iowait))

    sleep 1

    read cpu user nice system idle iowait irq softirq steal _ < /proc/stat
    local total2=$((user + nice + system + idle + iowait + irq + softirq + steal))
    local idle2=$((idle + iowait))

    local total_diff=$((total2 - total1))
    local idle_diff=$((idle2 - idle1))

    if [ "$total_diff" -eq 0 ]; then
        echo "0.0"
    else
        awk -v t="$total_diff" -v i="$idle_diff" 'BEGIN { printf "%.1f", (t - i) * 100 / t }'
    fi
}

# Write header
echo "===== CPU Monitoring Started at $(date '+%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S') =====" > "$LOG_FILE"

# Take 12 samples
for i in $(seq 1 $SAMPLES); do
    TIMESTAMP=$(date '+%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S')
    CPU_USAGE=$(get_cpu_usage)
    echo "[$TIMESTAMP] CPU: ${CPU_USAGE}%" >> "$LOG_FILE"

    # Sleep remainder of the 5-second interval (already slept 1s in get_cpu_usage)
    if [ "$i" -lt "$SAMPLES" ]; then
        sleep $((INTERVAL - 1))
    fi
done

# Write footer
echo "===== CPU Monitoring Completed at $(date '+%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S') =====" >> "$LOG_FILE"

echo "Monitoring complete. Log saved to $LOG_FILE"

    local idle1=$((idle + iowait))

    sleep 1

    read _ user nice system idle iowait irq softirq steal _ < /proc/stat
    local total2=$((user + nice + system + idle + iowait + irq + softirq + steal))
    local idle2=$((idle + iowait))

    local total_diff=$((total2 - total1))
    local idle_diff=$((idle2 - idle1))

    if [ "$total_diff" -eq 0 ]; then
        echo "0.0"
    else
        awk -v t="$total_diff" -v i="$idle_diff" 'BEGIN { printf "%.1f", (t - i) * 100 / t }'
    fi
}

# Write header
echo "===== CPU Monitoring Started at $(date '+%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S') =====" > "$LOG_FILE"

# Take 12 samples, every 5 seconds
for i in $(seq 1 $SAMPLES); do
    TIMESTAMP=$(date '+%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S')
    CPU_USAGE=$(get_cpu_usage)
    echo "[$TIMESTAMP] CPU: ${CPU_USAGE}%" >> "$LOG_FILE"

    # get_cpu_usage already slept 1s; sleep the remaining 4s between samples
    if [ "$i" -lt "$SAMPLES" ]; then
        sleep $((INTERVAL - 1))
    fi
done
